notes: Exact descriptions and complete inputSchema objects copied from current default-branch binary MCP tools/list, including nested $defs/ref and constraints.
No credentials provided; only initialize, notifications/initialized, and tools/list sent. Schema extraction does not exercise Meta API permissions or runtime validations.
Business asset, identity/account and mutation-plan tools included as supporting; all tools retained.

tools.name: apply_mutation_plan
tools.description: Send one reviewed, frozen Meta request once per apply. Requires APPLY_LIVE_META_ADS_CHANGES; deletes, status=DELETED, and reach/frequency cancel or release also require CONFIRM_META_ADS_REMOVALS.

apply_acknowledgement.description: Exact explicit approval phrase returned in the build guidance.

removal_acknowledgement.description: Required for deletes, status=DELETED, and reach/frequency cancellation/release actions.

tools.name: batch_catalog_items
tools.description: Upsert/delete bounded catalog items, including vertical, localized, geolocated, or versioned attributes. Returns an async handle; inspect read_catalog_batch_status before retrying.

data.description: Include the catalog identity inside data: PRODUCT_ITEM uses id; VEHICLE uses vehicle_id; FLIGHT uses origin_airport plus destination_airport. Other fields use the feed-format names documented for items_batch.

metadata.description: Optional documented per-record metadata for geolocated/versioned items; cannot override method or data.

data.description: Only identity fields, such as {"id":"SKU-1"} or {"vehicle_id":"CAR-1"}.

value.description: Language/country code, or language|country for LANGUAGE_AND_COUNTRY.

allow_upsert.description: Defaults to true for ordinary/geolocated/versioned batches; omitted for localized_items unless explicitly supplied. Localized batches require an existing base item.

item_sub_type.description: Optional item subtype, only for items.

item_type.description: Official item type, such as PRODUCT_ITEM, VEHICLE, HOTEL, FLIGHT or MEDIA_TITLE.

removal_acknowledgement.description: Required when any operation deletes an item.

version.description: Optional catalog batch version; unavailable for geolocated_items.

tools.name: batch_products
tools.description: Submit bounded catalog upserts and deletions; delete operations require CONFIRM_META_ADS_REMOVALS, and ambiguous outcomes require reconciliation.

BatchProductUpsert.description:
Product fields for Meta's batch/feed contract. Prices use decimal major
units because that contract differs from the single-product edge.

additional_fields.description:
Current Meta batch product fields not modeled above. These are flattened
into `data`; keys must not duplicate typed/control fields or contain secrets.

price_amount.description: Decimal major-unit amount without a currency suffix, such as `12.99`.

oneOf.description: Idempotently set fields on one retailer ID, creating it when allowed.
Permanently delete one retailer ID from the catalog.

allow_upsert.description: Let upserts create retailer IDs that do not exist. Defaults to true.

operations.description: One through 100 explicit upsert/delete operations with unique retailer IDs.

removal_acknowledgement.description: Required when any operation deletes a product, after operator approval; omit for upserts.

tools.name: build_mutation_plan
tools.description: Freeze one bounded Graph v26 create, update, or delete plan for campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives, custom audiences, or reach/frequency. Common delivery writes are validate-only checked; no live change occurs until apply_mutation_plan.

ad_account_id.description: Numeric Meta ad-account ID, with or without `act_`.

fields.description: Official Graph v26 form fields. Credentials, excluded messaging fields, and execution_options are rejected.

ad_account_id.description: Numeric Meta ad-account ID, with or without `act_`.

fields.description: Official Graph v26 form fields. Credentials, excluded messaging fields, and execution_options are rejected.

ad_account_id.description: Numeric Meta ad-account ID, with or without `act_`.

action.description: Exactly one frozen Graph mutation request. A plan is never described as atomic.

reason.description: Short operator-visible reason retained with the local plan preview.

tools.name: change_ad_labels
tools.description: Add or remove labels on one verified campaign, ad set, ad or creative. Other labels are preserved; removals require acknowledgement. At most 50 labels per call.

tools.name: clone_ad

ad_account_id.description: Expected source ad-account ID, with or without the `act_` prefix.

name_suffix.description: Optional copy-name suffix. Omit for Meta's localized default.

status.description: Status for the copy. Defaults to `PAUSED`; other values can begin delivery.

tools.name: clone_ad_set
tools.description: Copy one Meta ad set through the v26 copies edge; defaults to PAUSED and can optionally copy child ads.

ad_account_id.description: Expected source ad-account ID, with or without the `act_` prefix.

deep_copy.description: Copy child ads. Defaults to false and is subject to Meta's copy limits.

end_time.description: Optional UTC Unix end override; omit to inherit Meta's copy behavior.

start_time.description: Optional UTC Unix start override; omit to inherit Meta's copy behavior.

status.description: Status for the copy. Defaults to `PAUSED`.

target_campaign_id.description: Optional numeric campaign ID for a different parent campaign.

tools.description: Copy one Meta campaign through the v26 copies edge; the copy defaults to PAUSED.

strategy.description: Which copied object names Meta changes.

status.description: Status for the copy. Defaults to `PAUSED`.

tools.name: upload_catalog_feed
tools.description: Upload a product, hotel-room, or pricing-variable feed from public HTTPS or a CSV/TSV/XML/JSON file under META_MEDIA_ROOT (64 MiB maximum). Defaults to update-only; full replacement requires CONFIRM_META_ADS_REMOVALS.

local_format.description: Required with local_path: csv, tsv, xml, or json. Full feed validation runs in Meta.

local_path.description: Alternatively stream a relative file below META_MEDIA_ROOT, up to 64 MiB. Choose exactly one source.

parent_id.description: Feed ID for feed, catalog ID for hotel_rooms or pricing_variables.

removal_acknowledgement.description: Required for a full replacement upload (update_only=false).

standard.description: Optional provider standard for hotel_rooms/pricing_variables; omit for feed.

update_only.description: Update existing items only. Defaults to true; false may create/delete items according to feed settings.

url.description: Public HTTPS feed URL; credentials and signed credential query parameters are rejected.

tools.name: upload_page_ad_media
tools.description: Upload unpublished Page photos or videos for ads and Instant Experiences. Returns Page media IDs, unlike account image hashes. Requires Page post permissions; local files stay within META_MEDIA_ROOT.

oneOf.description: JPEG/PNG up to 15 MiB, or MP4/MOV up to 512 MiB, under META_MEDIA_ROOT.
Meta downloads this credential-free public HTTPS URL.

text.description: Photo caption or video description; does not publish a Page feed post.

tools.name: upsert_product
tools.description: Create or update one catalog product by stable retailer ID through Meta's v26 product edge.

additional_fields.description:
Current Meta product fields not modeled above, such as vertical-specific
attributes. Keys must not duplicate typed/control fields or contain secrets.

additional_image_urls.description: Up to ten public HTTPS secondary-image URLs.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code. Required with either price.

price_minor_units.description: Regular price in the currency's minor units, such as 1299 for USD 12.99.

retailer_id.description: Stable retailer/SKU ID, from 1 through 100 printable characters.

retailer_product_group_id.description: Stable retailer group ID for product variants.

sale_price_minor_units.description: Optional sale price in the same minor units; requires `currency`.

allow_upsert.description: Create the retailer ID when absent. Defaults to true.

product.description: Stable retailer product ID plus the fields to set.

tools.name: write_catalog_object
tools.description: Create or update a catalog, product set, feed, feed rule, schedule, group, or supported item. Fields follow Graph v26; creation may duplicate objects. Feed deletion requires explicit acknowledgement.

fields.description: Official v26 fields. Common fields: name, filter (sets), schedule/update_schedule (feeds), attribute/rule_type/params (rules). Schedules must be objects with credential-free HTTPS URLs.

removal_acknowledgement.description: Required when enabling feed deletion; otherwise omit.

target_id.description: Create: business ID for catalog; catalog ID for sets/feeds/items/groups; feed ID for rules/schedules. Update: object ID.
